desc: Prove the characterization of all legal edge additions in a bipartite graph, including edges inside a component and edges merging two components.
Exhaustively derive/conjecture the exact winner criterion on small states; specifically test whether terminal-length parity is fixed or strategically controllable.
Derive and prove a game invariant / strategy establishing the winner criterion, especially the odd-component case.
Determine the terminal complete-bipartite edge count from orientations of initial component bipartitions.
Implement iterative BFS/DFS bipartite coloring for all components and collect color-class counts.
Validate the proven formula on isolated vertices, disconnected edges, and already complete bipartite components.
